description: This file defines a React functional component 'AddAgentForm' that provides a user interface for creating and configuring different types of agents within the application. It manages form state, fetches agent type metadata, handles form submission logic for various agent types, and incorporates external components and network functions for agent creation.

classes.name: AddAgentForm
classes.description: React functional component for rendering and handling an agent creation form with dynamic fields based on agent type.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, constructs agent data based on selected agent type, calls API to create agent, and manages UI state during the process.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets form fields, resets agent type to default, and triggers onClose callback to close the modal.

methods.name: handleAgentTypeChange
methods.description: Updates the current agent type state and resets form fields when the user selects a different agent type.
